description:
Wake up. Capture the sky. Build a year of mornings.

Sky Grid gives you one small reason to get up: a sky photo that becomes part of your own growing mosaic. Moku, your little morning companion, is there to celebrate each capture.

MAKE MORNINGS A HABIT
Set your morning alarm, take one sky photo a day, and follow your streak and weekly rhythm.

KEEP A YEAR YOU CAN SEE
Watch your mosaic grow, then open a day to revisit its sky photo.

SHOW UP TOGETHER
Invite your friends. Your morning skies unlock for each other once you have both posted that day. Compare today's sky side by side with a buddy.

FREE TO START
Daily captures, up to 5 buddies, alarms, and your most recent 30 days of sky photos. No public feed to scroll.

GO FURTHER WITH PRO
Unlock your full photo archive, an unlimited circle of buddies, and a weekly recap card of your last 7 mornings. Choose a monthly or annual subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Prices are shown in the app before you buy.

NOW IN JAPANESE
Sky Grid is now fully available in English and Japanese, switchable anytime from Settings.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://skygrid.my/privacy
Terms of Use: https://skygrid.my/terms
